blocks.text: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy aik bohat powerful (taqatwar) technique hai. Yeh chemistry, polymer industry, proteins aur natural products ki study, environment ki monitoring (nigrani) aur medical field mein bohat use hoti hai. Chemistry mein yeh khaas taur par organic compounds ki identification (pehchan) aur un ka structure maloom karne ke liye use hoti hai. Is kaam ke liye do tareeqe sab se zyada use hote hain: proton (¹H) NMR aur carbon-13 (¹³C) NMR.

blocks.prompt: Organic chemistry mein NMR ke do sab se aam tareeqe kaun se hain?

items: NMR se organic compounds pehchane jate hain aur un ka structure maloom hota hai.
Do aam tareeqe: ¹H NMR aur ¹³C NMR.
